ar.meaning: حَفِظَ الشَّيْءَ وَحَمَاهُ مِنْ طَوَارِقِ التَّلَفِ وَالحَشَرَاتِ

de.meaning: Handschriften durch natürliche Vorkehrungen dauerhaft vor Verfall und Fraß schützen

en.infinitive: to conserve against vermin / safeguard manuscripts
en.meaning: to preserve documents and folios permanently against pestilence and atmospheric decay

conjugation_examples.ar: يَصُونُ خَشَبُ الأَرْزِ دَفَاتِرَ العِلْمِ قُرُونًا طَوِيلَةً.
conjugation_examples.de: Das Zedernholz bewahrt die Bücher der Gelehrsamkeit über viele Jahrhunderte.
conjugation_examples.en: The cedarwood conserves scholarly registers over long centuries.

conjugation_examples.ar: صَانَ خَازِنُ القَيْرَوَانِ مَصَاحِفَ المَسْجِدِ فِي صَنَادِيقِ الخَيْرِ.
conjugation_examples.de: Der Bibliothekar von Kairouan bewahrte die Korane in wohlbedachten Truhen.
conjugation_examples.en: The archivist of Kairouan safeguarded the mosque codices in noble chests.
